name: Earthing-switch motor operator interface
summary: Shows the control interface of the selected electrically operated earthing switch.
description: Shows the control interface of the selected electrically operated earthing switch. A switching-device operating reference adds the specific mechanism or duty context needed to interpret its place in a power circuit. The same basic switching outline can serve different equipment constructions, so the added description must remain attached to its device tag.

In a medium-voltage switchgear drawing, the operating reference helps the reader distinguish the interrupting device from its isolation, earthing and auxiliary-control interfaces. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Permitted earthing command” at the input and “Earthing-switch drive action” at the output. Earthing operation depends on the complete isolation scheme.
